title: Book Three · Chapter 78: An Early Afternoon
story:
On Thursday, Dad brings one of Mum's finished bags home from a customer.

He left Mr Sun's place at two again. On the way, he delivered a coat and brought the empty bag back.

Ronan finds him at the table after school. Dad is reading the customer's short note. Mum is looking at her work sheet.

“A better pocket?” Ronan asks.

“A different sleeve,” Mum says. “That is next week's question.”

She puts the note away. Dad stands and moves his cup from the table.

There is a new cushion on Mum's chair. The cover is dark, with a narrow strip of lighter cloth along one side.

Ronan touches the corner.

“Finished?”

“Yesterday,” she says.

Dad looks at it. “I asked to test it.”

“You tested it for an hour.”

“A careful test.”

Mum laughs. She sits on the cushion and takes her next coat from the basket.

Ronan opens his school book. He writes one line, then looks at the yard. Anna and Lin will be near the library now.

Dad watches him for a moment.

“The question outside?”

“No.”

Ronan puts the pencil down. He looks at both parents.

“Anna is my girlfriend.”

Mum stops her needle. Then she smiles.

“The girl with the window drawings?”

“Yes.”

“I thought you liked those windows a lot.”

Dad smiles too. “Does she know?”

Ronan laughs. “I asked her.”

“Good.”

For a moment, he feels younger and older at the same time. Mum only asks how Saturday went. He tells her about the park, the walk, and the two pages of maths afterward.

Ronan looks down at his book again. Then he looks back.

“Was it easy to ask Mum for a walk?” he asks Dad.

Dad takes a moment before he answers.

“No. I kept checking my shoes.”

Mum laughs.

“They were very tidy by the time he spoke.”

Dad looks at his work shoes near the door.

“Good shoes.”

Ronan laughs too. He has seen Dad speak to customers and argue about a difficult job. It is harder to picture him standing quietly with a question ready.

“What did you say?” he asks Mum.

“I went for the walk.”

She puts the coat more comfortably across her knees. Ronan can see the little smile still on her face.

He does not ask for every word. His own Saturday has parts he wants to keep for himself too. He pulls his book closer and lets the two adults finish their joke together.

Dad gets another cup from the kitchen. Then he goes to the yard with his own papers.

Mum returns to the coat. Ronan opens a clean sheet beside his school book and writes to Leo.

He tells him about Anna. The words look different on paper. He reads them once, then continues with news from the park.

Before the post office closes, he sends this thirteenth letter. He keeps his spending small and walks both ways.

When he comes home, Dad and Mum are looking at the household page again. The second week of shorter hours is nearly finished. They put off another purchase, but the food money is still in its place.

Dad goes to cook the rice. Mum asks Ronan about tomorrow's work at school.

He tells her, then pulls his book closer. Outside, the light is beginning to go. His first answer is already on the page when Dad calls them to the table.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

cushion cover＝靠垫套；strip＝窄条；put off＝推迟；purchase＝一笔购买、要买的东西。

## 理解问题

1. Dad提前下班后做了什么实际家务？这是否表示他已经失去在Mr Sun处的工作？
2. Mum的靠垫到了什么状态？Ronan向家人和Leo分别说清了哪件新事？

## 读句子

**Anna is my girlfriend.**

拆开看：Anna / is / my girlfriend.

Anna／是／我的女朋友。
